0.2.1:
• A clean new logo
• Pictures in chat: paste, drop or press +, with a caption
• Roles: make friends moderators or admins, and hand over a server
• Server settings → Members lists everyone, online or not
• Mark a server or channel as read from its menu
• Scrolled up? A bar counts new messages and jumps back down
• The update arrow, and your version under Settings → App
• Clear words when Hopp Cloud is busy
• Smaller fixes all over
0.2.2:
• Send files to friends: straight from your computer to theirs, never through the cloud
• Pictures in DMs and groups, end-to-end encrypted
• Edit and delete your DMs
• YouTube links show as cards and play right in the chat
• Invite friends straight from Invite people
• Pick a picture when you create a server
• Owners can turn pictures off for a server or a channel
• Smoother: new messages slide in, the chat no longer jumps
• Fixes changing your profile and server picture
0.2.3:
• Right-click a server, channel or person for what you need: Invite, Message, Call, Mention, Mute and more
• Invite friends in one click from Invite people
• YouTube videos keep playing while you chat, react or edit
• Type anywhere to start writing, with :emoji suggestions
• Quick reactions on hover, Mark unread, and Esc to catch up
• Page Up/Down, Ctrl+End and Jump to present (now in DMs too)
• Alt+arrows to move between channels
• Fixes DMs going missing when many arrive at once
0.2.4:
• Friends with the same name can both join a server
• Use Hopp on two computers at once, in the same server
• Voice through the relay recovers and renews by itself, even in long calls
• Files reach friends on blocked networks too (through the relay)
• Each person keeps their own volume, even with the same name
• Small fixes
0.2.5:
• A fresh look: one calm background for the whole window, and colour themes that flow from edge to edge
• Voice channels fill the view: everyone's tile, cameras and screens, full screen and the chat beside
• Calls with friends work the same way: camera, screen sharing, pop out and a size you drag
• Switching servers is instant: Hopp stays connected in the background
• Custom status, a profile banner and nicknames per server, and move and zoom your pictures before saving them
• Roles with colours, private channels, @everyone, @here and role mentions
• Moderation: timeouts, slowmode, bans that clean up messages, an audit log, moving and muting people in voice
• Soundboard, new soft sounds, and see where friends are in voice with one click to join
• Fixes all over: ringing that wouldn't stop, blinking when switching, resizing the window
0.2.6:
• Discover Hopp: the compass at the bottom of the server list opens a page of its own with what's new in every version, guides to everything Hopp can do, and about Hopp
• Move and zoom your profile picture and banner before saving them
0.2.7:
• Updates wait for you: the arrow at the top turns green when a new version is ready and you choose when to install it; click it any time to look for one
• About Hopp tells what Hopp is and what it stands for
